title: podrunner job offer, version 1
description: What a source driver sends when a job is available. Trust is derived from trust_inputs, never from labels and never from the tier of the set that delivered the job. A field the source cannot state is the string unknown, and an unknown input never gives the tier trusted: the job is untrusted only if it is a fork pull_request, and is refused with event-not-allowed otherwise (SPEC section 6.3). payload is optional. unit_need is optional: only a source that knows the container or port needs of a job states them. For GitHub they are discovered at hook time.

then.description: A scale-set message carries no payload data, so a github-scaleset source never states a payload. slots takes it from the pin list entry of the set.

job_id.description: Data from the source. Never a path component.

source.description: KIND/INSTANCE. INSTANCE is the key of a [[source]] table of the configuration.

actor_class.description: member: the actor is a member of the organization named by owner. Resolved by the source.

owner_id.description: Optional numeric id of the owner. When present the rule compares ids as well as names.

repo_id.description: Optional numeric id of the repository.

labels.description: Kept for the log and for the source's own set matching. Never an input of the tier rule.

unit_need.description: Optional. min_boundary can only raise the minimum of the tier, never lower it.

payload.description: Optional. Present only when the source is marked payload_from_offer, and never in an offer of a github-scaleset source. Otherwise slots takes the payload from the pin list entry of the set, and a payload in the offer is ignored and audited.

image.description: An image reference pinned by digest. Must match an entry of the pin list unless the source is marked payload_from_offer.

image_max_age_days.description: The age limit is the smaller of this value and the max_age_days of the pin.

policy.description: The egress policy of the job. The full form is validated by tools/check_schemas.py against inputs/broker-policy.v1.schema.json, the copy of the pod-broker policy schema. version is required there.
